touches.text: Owns the inspectors and gates (draft, moving from standalone): build_inspector, plan_inspector, ticket_inspector, corrosion, exemptions, rehearsal, determinism, import_sieve, and the tester (11; Q#33, Akien 2026-10-29). (Not diagnostic_inspector: it is base's, 17.3.) The code pipeline's inspectors and gates move to CodeMother; any that are not about code (if such existed) would not. (Q#31, Akien 2026-10-27)
harbor_master (machine, CodeMother's; was the Cairn device's 5.9, moved with the gates and inspectors, Akien 2026-11-04)
VERBS: crossing, watch. (clear, the PROVED gate it used to house, is CodeMother's with the other gates: CC's reading of 10.8.2.2.)
artifact: the one door a record of truth changes through, and the journal of who came through it (hash-chained, caller read from the kernel). USERS: everyone who writes a record.

ROOT INTENTION for checks and gates (Akien, 2026-10-27): the inspector does all the checks, so there is no need for more checks anywhere else. The inspector's output is consumed by the gate. The gate's output is the certificate. "This was how I meant it all along."

The crossing is the ticket's own act. The gate's probe (the same kind that sends notice of gate passage) tells the passing ticket "you can now advance to X", and the ticket updates itself. (Q#61, Akien 2026-10-27)
